premise.claim: JuiceFSRuntime cannot express imagePullSecrets at spec / worker / fuse level; only the controller-wide IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS env exists (issue #4222, OPEN).
premise.evidence: git grep at base: no ImagePullSecrets in juicefsruntime_types.go, no Spec.ImagePullSecrets reads in pkg/ddc/juicefs; transformWorkers at base only reads the env default. AlluxioRuntime has the whole hierarchy at base (differential parity). See results/premise-base-evidence.txt.

findings.claim: Under JuiceFSRuntime with spec/worker/fuse imagePullSecrets and/or the controller env default, transform() produces value.ImagePullSecrets (env default, replaced by spec.imagePullSecrets) and value.Worker/Fuse.ImagePullSecrets (component-level) with component > runtime > env precedence, and the marshaled values expose exactly the keys the chart reads.
match: prefers the runtime and worker secrets
uses the controller default when the runtime sets no secrets
sets the fuse secrets only when the fuse spec has them

findings.claim: The juicefs chart renders the worker StatefulSet and fuse DaemonSet with pod-level imagePullSecrets = component secrets when set, else the global value; helm template on the real chart with the values produced by the real transform() shows the contract end to end.

An existing install that sets only the controller env IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS and no new spec fields renders the same pods as before the PR (both worker and fuse pods keep the env-default secret; nothing new appears).

docs/{en,zh}/dev/api_doc.md (generated by `make update-api-doc`, pinned crd-ref-docs v0.3.0) place the three JuiceFS imagePullSecrets rows in the sections their Go comments define: JuiceFSCompTemplateSpec table (description containing 'Only the worker uses it for now'), JuiceFSFuseSpec table ('JuiceFS fuse image'), JuiceFSRuntimeSpec table ('all JuiceFS components', NOT the fuse wording); no JuiceFS imagePullSecrets row appears in any other section (no strays under `#### JuiceFSRuntime` or the Vineyard `#### MasterSpec`).

Editing imagePullSecrets on an EXISTING JuiceFSRuntime propagates through the sync path (JuiceFSEngine.SyncRuntime, the entry point base/syncs.go calls on every reconcile): the worker StatefulSet and fuse DaemonSet pod templates get the new effective secrets (component > runtime > env, removal reverts to the env default / clears), the fuse generation label is bumped exactly when the live fuse template's secrets change, the values configmap records what was synced (including component overrides even when the effective list is unchanged), a change confined to one component does not touch the other, and a no-op sync re-bumps nothing. Round-4 harness-update: the 'configmap predating the feature' scenario now asserts the fuse generation is NOT bumped for a bookkeeping-only catch-up (the live template already carries the desired secrets); that expectation fails on d7e3168, so it bites.

docs/{en,zh}/samples/image_pull_secrets.md must not keep claiming that changing imagePullSecrets on an existing runtime 'needs the runtime to be recreated' (en) / '需要重新创建 runtime' (zh), because commit d7e3168 propagates such changes to the worker StatefulSet and (with a generation bump) the fuse DaemonSet. RED on head d7e3168 (stale claim present in both languages); GREEN once the sentence is updated.

F-worker-lost-update-missing-scriptcm (round 3, preexisting mechanism, PR-introduced field): while the worker-script configmap is missing, syncWorkerSpec early-returns after the in-memory bookkeeping, so the values configmap advances past the worker StatefulSet. The PERMANENCE must be gone: once the script configmap is restored, the next SyncRuntime must converge the worker template (the comparison is against the live template, not the saved value). RED on d7e3168 (second reconcile a no-op, worker stuck on the old secrets), GREEN on be3337d.

F-sync-strategy-flip-advance (round 3, PR-introduced): with a non-OnDelete worker update strategy the first sync flips the strategy and returns while the values configmap advances; the next reconcile must then converge the worker template. RED on d7e3168 (worker stuck on the old secrets permanently), GREEN on be3337d.

F-sync-override-not-recorded (round 3, PR-introduced): rotating the runtime-wide secrets a->b while adding a worker override set to a is an effective no-op for the worker, but the override must be recorded in the values configmap; removing the override later must then drop the worker onto b. RED on d7e3168 (override never recorded; after removal the worker stays on a permanently), GREEN on be3337d. End-to-end version of the author's leaf-level TestSyncImagePullSecretsRotationThenOverrideRemoval.

docs/{en,zh}/samples/image_pull_secrets.md must not claim a secrets change restarts the running fuse pods (fuse DS is OnDelete, default clean policy OnRuntimeDeleted); they must state the keep-old-secrets-until-deleted default. Round-5 finding F-docs-fuse-restart-overstated; fixed by a0baafae0.
